name: The Red Cistern (station 3, Trap L1; PLAN.md sections 4.3 and 6): Al-Jubb al-Ahmar on the NW Twin's south apron at 4,890 m (0.87 atm), the guides' active lava-pool trap: a decoy lava tube behind a wide basalt arch carved with counterfeit tally-marks, warm air wafting out, running 600 m down at 6 degrees past a fork and the guide's raised bench into a blind collapse amphitheatre open to the sky, its floor a churning 1,150 C lava pond 90 m across roofed at its margins by a paper-thin ash-dusted blister crust; CO2 and SO2 pooling in the low, abandoned strongboxes on the rim; the NW Twin 16 km off
